guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 打开官方 CT 领取页面
guide.description: 打开 Concrete Foundation 的领取页面。Concrete 已提醒用户警惕虚假领取网站，因此只使用 concretefoundation.xyz，或 Concrete 官方 X、Discord 提供的链接。来源另附空投安全指南，说明操作前应检查的事项。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Visit the Official CT Claim Page
guide.original_description: Go to the Concrete Foundation claim page . Concrete has warned about fake claim sites, so only use concretefoundation.xyz or links from Concrete’s official X and Discord. Our airdrop safety guide covers what to check first.

guide.title: 连接符合资格的钱包
guide.description: 连接此前用于 Concrete 金库或积分面板的钱包。支持 MetaMask 及其他由自己保管的 EVM 钱包。必须使用自己拥有并控制的钱包，领取资格不能转移到其他地址。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Connect the wallet you used for Concrete vaults or the Points dashboard. MetaMask and other self-custody EVM wallets work. The wallet must be one you own and control, and eligibility can’t be moved to a different address.

guide.title: 接受领取条款并查看获配数量
guide.description: 接受 CT 领取条款，查看获配数量和领取截止时间。界面会根据 IP 屏蔽受限地区；使用 VPN 绕过限制违反条款，可能导致领取被阻止。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Accept the Claim Terms and Check Your Allocation
guide.original_description: Accept the CT Claim Terms to see your allocation and the claim deadline. The interface blocks restricted jurisdictions by IP, and using a VPN to get around this breaks the terms and can get your claim blocked.

guide.title: 准备支付手续费所需的 ETH
guide.description: 领取是一笔链上交易，因此钱包中应保留少量 ETH。原文提供了在 Bybit 购买 ETH，或通过来源页面下方组件从其他链转入 ETH 的选项。原文还包含组件宣传：支持 30 多条链，宣称路由快速、费用较低；点击立即跨链（Bridge now）打开组件，也可在新标签页打开。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: The claim is an on-chain transaction, so keep a small amount of ETH in the wallet. You can buy ETH on Bybit , or move ETH over from another chain with the bridge widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

guide.title: 领取 CT 代币
guide.description: 点击领取（Claim），然后确认交易。只有交易在链上确认后，领取才会生效；如果页面没有更新，可在区块浏览器中查看交易状态。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Click “Claim” and confirm the transaction. The claim only counts once it confirms on-chain, so check the explorer if the page doesn’t update.

guide.title: 将 CT 添加到钱包
guide.description: 导入官方 CT 合约，让钱包显示余额：0x0A092E544DA31150b439a1aAA1A3a2214a867F46。Ethereum 和 BNB Chain 使用相同地址。不要把钱包中出现的其他“CT”代币当作同一资产。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Import the official CT contract so the balance shows up: 0x0A092E544DA31150b439a1aAA1A3a2214a867F46 . The same address is used on Ethereum and BNB Chain. Ignore any other “CT” token that appears in your wallet.

guide.title: 在 Concrete 应用质押或锁定 CT
guide.description: 如果计划长期持有，可打开 Concrete 应用。质押 CT 可降低自己参与金库活动的协议费用；锁定 CT 可获得对策略批准、抵押资产规则及费用框架的投票权。治理功能正分阶段推出。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Stake or Lock CT in the Concrete App
guide.original_description: Open the Concrete app if you plan to hold. Staking CT can reduce protocol fees on your own vault activity, and locking CT gives voting power over strategy approvals, collateral rules, and fee frameworks. Governance is rolling out in stages.

sourcedDescription: The Concrete (CT) airdrop is confirmed and claimable. CT reached its TGE on September 30, 2026, and eligible wallets can now claim through the official Concrete Foundation site. Only addresses on the CT Eligibility List can claim, and each allocation is locked to the wallet it was assigned to.
tagline_en: The Concrete (CT) airdrop is confirmed and claimable. CT reached its TGE on September 30, 2026, and eligible wallets can now claim through the official Concrete Foundation site. Only addresses on the CT Eligibility List can claim, and each allocation is locked to the wallet it was assigned to.

sourcedSteps.title: Visit the Official CT Claim Page
sourcedSteps.body: Go to the Concrete Foundation claim page . Concrete has warned about fake claim sites, so only use concretefoundation.xyz or links from Concrete’s official X and Discord. Our airdrop safety guide covers what to check first.

sourcedSteps.title: Connect Your Eligible Wallet
sourcedSteps.body: Connect the wallet you used for Concrete vaults or the Points dashboard. MetaMask and other self-custody EVM wallets work. The wallet must be one you own and control, and eligibility can’t be moved to a different address.

sourcedSteps.title: Accept the Claim Terms and Check Your Allocation
sourcedSteps.body: Accept the CT Claim Terms to see your allocation and the claim deadline. The interface blocks restricted jurisdictions by IP, and using a VPN to get around this breaks the terms and can get your claim blocked.

sourcedSteps.title: Add ETH for Gas
sourcedSteps.body: The claim is an on-chain transaction, so keep a small amount of ETH in the wallet. You can buy ETH on Bybit , or move ETH over from another chain with the bridge widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

sourcedSteps.title: Claim Your CT Tokens
sourcedSteps.body: Click “Claim” and confirm the transaction. The claim only counts once it confirms on-chain, so check the explorer if the page doesn’t update.

sourcedSteps.title: Add CT to Your Wallet
sourcedSteps.body: Import the official CT contract so the balance shows up: 0x0A092E544DA31150b439a1aAA1A3a2214a867F46 . The same address is used on Ethereum and BNB Chain. Ignore any other “CT” token that appears in your wallet.

sourcedSteps.title: Stake or Lock CT in the Concrete App
sourcedSteps.body: Open the Concrete app if you plan to hold. Staking CT can reduce protocol fees on your own vault activity, and locking CT gives voting power over strategy approvals, collateral rules, and fee frameworks. Governance is rolling out in stages.
